intro_payload.title: 🏛️ Desh Ki Planning: Zero Se Hero Tak
intro_payload.subtitle: Class 8th Raju Ke Saath Aasaan Bhasha Mein
learning_outcomes: Planning kya hoti hai aur desh ko iski zarurat kyun padi?
Azadi se pehle planning ke sapne (Visvesvaraya se Sarvodaya Plan tak)
Planning Commission (1950) aur NDC (1952) kaise bane?
First Plan (1951) se lekar 12th Plan (2017) tak ki poori kahani
BPSC aur SSC ke basic to advance MCQs
1 January 2015 ko NITI Aayog kaise aur kyun bana?
NITI Aayog ka structure: PM, VC, CEO aur Sabhi Mukhyamantri
NITI Aayog ke report card: SDG Index, Garibi Index (MPI) aur Atal Tinkering Labs
⭐ Bihar State Planning Board aur Saat Nischay (Part 1 & 2)
BPSC aur SSC level ke easy-to-advance practice sawaal

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, agar main tumhe 100 rupaye pocket money doon aur kahoon ki pure mahine ka kharcha chalao, to tum kya karoge?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, main pehle ek copy par likhunga ki kitne ki copy khareedni hai, kitni pencil aur kitne bachaane hain. Bina soche kharch kiya to 2 din mein paisa khatam ho jayega!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Shabash! Isi hisab-kitab aur soch-samajh kar kharch karne ko 'Planning' (Yojana) kehte hain. Ab socho, jab 1947 mein hamara desh azad hua, tab desh ke paas bhi paisa kam tha aur log bahut gareeb the. To pure desh ko chalane ke liye planning ki zarurat padi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Acha! Matlab jaise hum ghar ka budget banate hain, waise hi sarkar pure desh ke liye planning karti hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Desh mein planning ka idea sabse pehle 1934 mein ek bahut bade engineer M. Visvesvaraya ji ne diya. Unhone ek kitab likhi — 'Planned Economy for India'.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, unhone kitab mein kya likha tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Unhone kaha ki agar desh se garibi hatani hai, to agle 10 saal ke liye ek pakka plan banana padega aur karkhane (factories) lagane padenge. Isliye unhe Indian Planning ka pehla vicharak mana jata hai. Unke birthday (15 September) par hum 'Engineers' Day' manate hain!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wah! Ye to school mein bhi bataya gaya tha!

quiz_payload.question: 1934 mein 'Planned Economy for India' naamak mashhoor kitab kisne likhi thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: M. Visvesvaraya ji ne 1934 mein ye kitab likhi thi, jisme unhone 10-saal ke planning model ka sujhav diya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Fir saal 1938 aaya. Congress ke neta the Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose. Unhone kaha ki azadi ke baad desh kaise chalega, iske liye abhi se ek committee banao. Uska naam rakha 'National Planning Committee' (NPC).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, is committee ka head kisko banaya gaya tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru ko iska Chairman banaya gaya. Nehru ji ne alag-alag scientists aur arthshastriyon (economists) ko bulakar plan banwana shuru kiya.

navigation.button_text: Ameer Log aur Gandhi Ji Ka Plan ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
1944 mein do aur plans aaye:
1. Bombay Plan: Mumbai ke 8 bade udyogpatiyon (jaise JRD Tata, GD Birla) ne milkar plan banaya ki factories kaise lagein.
2. Gandhian Plan: Shriman Narayan Agarwal ne banaya, unhone kaha ki factory ke bajaye kheti aur gaon ke chhote udyog (cottage industries) par zor do.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Acha! Bombay wale factory chahte the aur Gandhi ji gaon ka vikas chahte the!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Do aur ahem plans yaad rakho:
• People's Plan (1945): M.N. Roy ne banaya (majdooron aur kisanon ke liye).
• Sarvodaya Plan (January 1950): Hamare Bihar ke mashhoor neta Jaiprakash Narayan (JP) ne banaya! Isme kheti, gaon aur sabke vikas ki baat thi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: JP Narayan ji to wahi hain na jinke naam par Patna mein airport hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan bilkul wahi! Aur ye sawaal BPSC mein bar-bar aata hai.

quiz_payload.question: January 1950 mein 'Sarvodaya Plan' kisne prastut kiya tha?
quiz_payload.explanation: Sarvodaya Plan Bihar ke mahan swatantrata senani Jaiprakash Narayan (JP) dwara 1950 mein taiyar kiya gaya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 15 March 1950 ko sarkar ne tay kiya ki ek aisi permanent team banai jaye jo desh ka plan banaye. Uska naam rakha gaya 'Planning Commission' (Yojana Aayog). Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru iske pehle Chairman bane.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, ye team sarkar ne order nikal kar banayi ya samvidhan (Constitution) mein likha tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut achha sawaal Raju! Samvidhan mein iska koi zikr nahi tha. Cabinet ke ek normal aadesh (Executive Resolution) se ise banaya gaya tha. Isliye isko 'Extra-Constitutional' aur 'Non-Statutory' body kehte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, mujhe 'Extra-Constitutional' word thoda mushkil lag raha hai. Aasan tarike se bataiye na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Dekho Raju, school ke niyam-pustika mein jo rule likha hota hai, wo 'Constitutional' jaisa hai (jaise Election Commission Article 324 mein likha hai). Lekin Principal sir ne bina rule-book badle koi temporary club bana diya, to wo 'Extra-Constitutional' ho gaya. Planning Commission samvidhan ki kitaab mein nahi tha, sarkar ke aadesh se bana tha!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ab samajh gaya Sir! Matlab sarkar jab chahe ise aadesh dekar band bhi kar sakti thi!

quiz_payload.question: Planning Commission (Yojana Aayog) ka samvidhanik darja (status) kya tha?

options.text: Ye Parliament ke Kanoon se bani Statutory body thi
Ye Cabinet ke aadesh se bani Extra-Constitutional body thi
Ye Supreme Court ka hissa thi

quiz_payload.explanation: Planning Commission ek Extra-Constitutional (Gair-Samvidhanik) body thi, jise Union Cabinet ke resolution se banaya gaya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Planning Commission ki structure dekho:
1. Chairman: Desh ke Prime Minister (Ex-officio, matlab jo bhi PM banega, wo khud-ba-khud Chairman ban jayega).
2. Deputy Chairman: PM dwara chuna gaya mukhya aadmi (iski power Cabinet Minister jaisi hoti thi).
3. Members: Finance Minister, Defence Minister aur kheti/industry ke experts.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, pehle Deputy Chairman kaun the?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Pehle Deputy Chairman the Gulzarilal Nanda aur aakhiri the Montek Singh Ahluwalia. Ye dono naam exams mein seedhe aate hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Planning Commission to Delhi mein baith kar plan bana leti thi. Lekin rajyon ke Chief Ministers (jaise Bihar, UP, Bengal ke CM) bole ki 'Hamse to pucha hi nahi!'. Isliye 6 August 1952 ko sarkar ne banaya NDC — National Development Council (Rashtriya Vikas Parishad).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: NDC kya karti thi Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Planning Commission jo bhi 5 saal ka plan banati, NDC usko padhkar final pass (approve) karti thi. Isme sabhi rajyon ke Chief Ministers shamil hote the.

quiz_payload.question: National Development Council (NDC / Rashtriya Vikas Parishad) ki sthapna kab hui thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: NDC ka gathan 6 August 1952 ko hua tha taaki Five Year Plans ko sabhi rajyon ke Chief Ministers ke saath milkar final approval diya ja sake.

navigation.button_text: Five Year Plan Kya Hota Hai? ➔

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, ye 'Five Year Plan' (Panchvarshiya Yojana) kya hota hai? 5 saal hi kyun?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Jaise tum school mein 1 saal ka target banate ho ki 8th class pass karni hai, waise hi sarkar 5 saal ka target banati thi ki agle 5 saal mein kitne baandh (dams) banane hain, kitne school kholne hain aur kitna anaj ugana hai. Ye 5-saal wala idea humne Russia (USSR) se seekha tha!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Acha! Russia se copy kiya tha!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
First Five-Year Plan (1951 se 1956):
• Model: Harrod-Domar Model (do arthshastriyon ke naam par).
• Main Focus: Kheti (Agriculture) aur Sinchai (Irrigation).
• Bade Kaam: Bhakra Nangal Baandh, Hirakud Baandh aur Damodar Valley Project bane.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Pehle plan mein kheti par hi sabse zyada dhyan kyun diya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Kyunki azadi ke time desh mein anaj ki bahut kami thi, log bhookhe mar rahe the. Pehle pet bharna zaroori tha na!

quiz_payload.question: Bharat ki Pehli Panchvarshiya Yojana (1951-56) kis model par aadharit thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: First Plan Harrod-Domar model par based thi jisme agriculture aur irrigation ko sabse top priority di gayi thi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Second Five-Year Plan (1956 se 1961):
• Model: P.C. Mahalanobis Model (ye Bharat ke bahut bade sankhyiki vidwan/statistician the).
• Main Focus: Badi Factories aur Steel Plants (Heavy Industry).
• Bade Karkhane: Bhilai Steel Plant (Russia ki madad se), Rourkela (Germany ki madad se) aur Durgapur (Britain ki madad se) lagaye gaye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab 1st Plan mein kheti, aur 2nd Plan mein factory!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi sequence pakde Raju!

quiz_payload.question: Doosri Panchvarshiya Yojana (1956-61) ka mukhya focus kis par tha?

options.text: Bhaari Udyog (Heavy Industries) aur Steel Plants

quiz_payload.explanation: Second Plan (P.C. Mahalanobis Model) ka mukhya uddeshya heavy industries aur steel plants lagana tha.

navigation.button_text: Teesri Yojana Aur Yuddh Ka Sankat ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Third Five-Year Plan (1961 se 1966):
• Target tha: Kheti aur Industry dono ko aatmanirbhar banana.
• Lekin ye yojana buri tarah fail ho gayi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Fail kyun ho gayi Sir? Kya hua tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1962 mein China ne hamle kar diya, fir 1965 mein Pakistan se yuddh ho gaya, aur 1965-66 mein bhayanak sookha (drought) pad gaya. Desh ka saara paisa fauj aur anaj bachane mein chala gaya.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Yuddh aur sookhe ki wajah se sarkar ke paas 5 saal ka plan banane ke paise nahi bache. Isliye 1966 se 1969 tak teen saal koi 5-year plan nahi bana. Is 3 saal ke break ko 'Plan Holiday' (Yojana Avkash) kehte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To in 3 saal mein desh bina plan ke kaise chala?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Har 1 saal ka chhota-chhota plan bana (Annual Plans). Aur isi dauran Dr. M.S. Swaminathan ne 'Harit Kranti' (Green Revolution) shuru ki — jisse gehun aur chawal ki paidawar achanak badh gayi!

quiz_payload.question: Bharat mein 'Plan Holiday' (Yojana Avkash) kis samayavadhi ke dauran raha?
quiz_payload.explanation: 1966 se 1969 tak teen saal yuddh aur sookhe ke karan koi Five Year Plan nahi bana, jise Plan Holiday kaha jata hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Fourth Five-Year Plan (1969 se 1974):
• PM Indira Gandhi ke time bana.
• Gadgil Formula par aadharit tha.
• 1969 mein 14 bade private banko ko sarkari (Nationalise) banaya gaya taaki kisanon ko aasan loan mile.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, isi plan mein 1971 ka Bangladesh yuddh bhi hua tha na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul! 1971 ka yuddh hua aur May 1974 mein Pokhran mein Bharat ne apna pehla parmanu parikshan (Smiling Buddha) kiya!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974 se 1979):
• Model: D.D. Dhar Model.
• Slogan: 'Garibi Hatao' (Poverty Eradication).
• Isme garibon ke liye 'Minimum Needs Programme' shuru hua.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, ye plan poore 5 saal chala tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi! 1977 mein sarkar badal gayi aur Morarji Desai PM bane. Unhone is plan ko 1978 mein (1 saal pehle) hi khatam kar diya!

quiz_payload.question: 'Garibi Hatao' aur 'Minimum Needs Programme' kis Panchvarshiya Yojana ka mukhya hissa the?
quiz_payload.explanation: Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-79) mein Garibi Hatao aur Minimum Needs Programme shuru kiya gaya tha, jise 1978 mein 1 saal pehle samapt kar diya gaya.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Jab 1978 mein 5th plan ruka, to nayi sarkar ne 1978 se 1980 tak 'Rolling Plan' chalaya. Ye idea Gunnar Myrdal naam ke arthshastri ne diya tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Rolling Plan matlab kya sir, pahiya ghumta tha kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haha nahi Raju! Iska matlab tha ki 5 saal ke liye fix mat baitho, har saal plan ko check karo aur jarurat ke hisab se aage badhate raho (roll karte raho). 1980 mein jab Indira Gandhi wapas aayi, to unhone ise band karke 6th plan shuru kiya.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980 se 1985):
• Target: Garibi par seedha hamla aur kisanon ki aarthik madad.
• 12 July 1982 ko NABARD Bank bana (kisanon aur gaon ke vikas ke liye sabse bada bank).
• 1982 mein EXIM Bank (videshi vyapar ke liye) bana.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, NABARD ka naam to gaon mein sabhi kisan jaante hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Aur exam mein ye date 12 July 1982 pakki aati hai!

quiz_payload.question: Kheti aur gaon ke vikas ka mukhya bank 'NABARD' kis Panchvarshiya Yojana mein sthapit hua?
quiz_payload.explanation: NABARD ki sthapna 12 July 1982 ko Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980-85) ke antargat B. Sivaraman Committee ki sifarish par hui thi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Seventh Plan (1985–90): 'Food, Work & Productivity' slogan tha. Jawahar Rozgar Yojana (1989) shuru hui.
Lekin 1990–92 mein desh mein aarthik sankat (BoP Crisis) aa gaya. Desh ke paas videshi paisa khatam ho gaya tha!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Fir kya hua Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1991 mein Dr. Manmohan Singh aur PM Narasimha Rao ne 'LPG Reforms' (Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation) shuru kiye, jisse private companies ko aane ki chhoot mili.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Eighth Plan (1992–97): Manav Sansadhan (Education, Health, Employment) par zor. 15 August 1995 ko 'Mid-Day Meal Scheme' shuru hui taaki bache school aayein!
Ninth Plan (1997–2002): Desh ke 50 saal pure hone par bani. Slogan tha 'Samajik Nyay ke saath Vikas'.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Mid-Day meal to humare school mein bhi milta hai garma-garam khana!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, ye 8th plan ki hi den hai!

quiz_payload.question: School ke bachhon ke liye prasiddh 'Mid-Day Meal Scheme' (1995) kis plan mein shuru hui?
quiz_payload.explanation: Mid-Day Meal Scheme 15 August 1995 ko Eighth Five-Year Plan (1992-97) ke dauran shuru ki gayi thi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Tenth Plan (2002–07): MGNREGA kanoon (2005) pass hua, jisse har garib ko 100 din ke rozgar ki guarantee mili.
Eleventh Plan (2007–12): Theme thi 'Faster and More Inclusive Growth' (Sabka Saath Sabka Vikas type). Is plan mein Bharat ki growth rate lagbhag 8% rahi jo sabse tez thi!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 100 din ka rozgar gaon mein sabhi mazdooron ko milta hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Twelfth Plan (2012–17): Ye Bharat ki LAST (aakhiri) Five-Year Plan thi! Theme thi — 'Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth'.
2014 mein nayi sarkar aayi aur Planning Commission ko band kar diya gaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, to kya 13th Five Year Plan kabhi nahi bani?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi! 13th plan kabhi nahi aayi. Five-Year Plans ka chapter 12th plan ke sath hamesha ke liye band ho gaya!

quiz_payload.question: Bharat ki AAKHIRI (Last) Panchvarshiya Yojana kaun si thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: Twelfth Plan (2012-2017) Bharat ki last Five-Year Plan thi. Iske baad 13th plan nahi aayi.

navigation.button_text: Planning Commission Ko Kyun Band Kiya? ➔

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, jab Planning Commission itna sara kaam kar rahi thi, to ise band kyun kiya gaya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
3 badi kamiyan thi Raju:
1. Top-Down Approach: Delhi mein baith kar neta log Bihar ke gaon ka faisla karte the, bina zameen ki haqeeqat dekhe.
2. Sabko ek hi chashme se dekhna: Jo niyam pahadi rajya ke liye banta, wahi registan ya flood wale rajya par thop diya jata tha.
3. Rajyon ki kam sunwai: Mukhyamantriyon ke paas zyada taqat nahi thi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab sabhi states ko apni marzi se plan banane ka haq nahi tha!

quiz_payload.question:
Nimnlikhit kathano par vichar karein:
1. Planning Commission ka gathan samvidhan ke Article 280 ke antargat hua tha.
2. National Development Council (NDC) mein sabhi rajyon ke Chief Ministers shamil the.
3. First Five-Year Plan mein mukhya focus kheti aur sinchai par tha.

Inme se kaun se kathan SAHI hain?
quiz_payload.explanation: Kathan 1 galat hai (Article 280 mein Finance Commission hai, Planning Commission samvidhan mein nahi thi). Kathan 2 aur 3 bilkul sahi hain.

quiz_payload.question:
Sahi jodi milayein:
(A) First Five Year Plan — (1) Mahalanobis Model (Steel Plants)
(B) Second Five Year Plan — (2) Harrod-Domar Model (Kheti)
(C) Sixth Five Year Plan — (3) 12 July 1982 (NABARD)

Sahi code chunein:
quiz_payload.explanation: 1st Plan = Harrod-Domar (Kheti); 2nd Plan = Mahalanobis (Bhaari Udyog); 6th Plan = NABARD Bank (1982).

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, ab batao — kya tumhe 1934 se lekar 2017 tak ka poora itihaas aur saare plans clear hue?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, pehle mujhe ye topic bahut boring aur mushkil lagta tha. Par ab samajh aa gaya ki kaise kheti se shuru hokar factory, fir bank, fir technology aur 12th plan tak desh aage badha!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Shabash Raju! Ab agle part (Part 2: Cards 41 se 80) mein hum dekhenge ki 2015 mein Planning Commission ki jagah NITI Aayog kaise aaya aur hamare Bihar mein planning kaise chalti hai!

cards.topic_title: NITI Aayog, Indices & Bihar State Planning (Part 2/2)

intro_payload.title: 🚀 NITI Aayog Aur Hamara Bihar (Part 2)
intro_payload.subtitle: Planning Commission Ke Baad Ka Naya Daur

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, 1 January 2015 ko sarkar ne purane Planning Commission ko hata kar ek naya sansthan banaya — NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, NITI ka matlab wahi hota hai na jo hum Hindi mein 'neeti' (rule ya policy) kehte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Iska poora naam English mein 'National Institution for Transforming India' hai. Ye bhi purane Planning Commission ki tarah Cabinet ke normal aadesh (Executive Resolution) se bana. Matlab ye bhi Extra-Constitutional aur Non-Statutory body hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, akhbar mein likha rehta hai ki NITI Aayog sarkar ka 'Think Tank' hai. Think Tank ka kya matlab hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Think Tank ka matlab hota hai 'Dimag Lagane Wali Team' (Sochne-Vicharne Wali Team)! Jaise cricket match se pehle coach aur captain baith kar strategy banate hain ki match kaise jeetna hai, waise hi NITI Aayog sarkar ko acche-acche ideas aur salah (advice) deta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Acha! To ye sarkar ko sirf salah deta hai, khud order nahi deta?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi pakde Raju! NITI Aayog ek Salahkar (Advisory) body hai.

quiz_payload.question: NITI Aayog ki sthapna kis din hui thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: NITI Aayog 1 January 2015 ko Planning Commission ko replace karke sthapit kiya gaya tha.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog ki team ka hisab dekho:
1. Chairperson (Adhyaksh): Desh ke Prime Minister.
2. Vice-Chairperson (Upaadhyaksh): PM dwara appoint kiya jata hai (Cabinet Minister ka rank milta hai). Pehle VC the Arvind Panagariya.
3. CEO (Chief Executive Officer): Ek senior IAS officer. Pehli CEO thi Sindhushree Khullar.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, Governing Council kya hoti hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Governing Council sabse ahem hai! Isme Bharat ke SABHI rajyon ke Chief Ministers aur sabhi Union Territories ke Lieutenant Governors baithte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, 'Cooperative Federalism' ka matlab kya hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Cooperative matlab 'Mil-jul kar kaam karna' aur Federalism matlab 'Centre aur State Sarkar'. Purane Planning Commission mein Delhi se aadesh aata tha aur rajya follow karte the. NITI Aayog mein Centre aur sabhi State ke CMs aamne-saamne baith kar faisla karte hain — Team India bankar!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab ab Bihar ke CM ki baat bhi Delhi mein seedhe suni jaati hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, isko kehte hain Bottom-Up Approach (Neeche se Upar ki taraf faisla)!

quiz_payload.question: NITI Aayog ki 'Governing Council' mein nimnlikhit mein se kaun shamil hote hain?

options.text: Sabhi Rajyon ke Chief Ministers aur UTs ke Lt. Governors

quiz_payload.explanation: NITI Aayog ki Governing Council mein Prime Minister ke saath sabhi rajyon ke Mukhyamantri (CMs) aur UTs ke Lt. Governors shamil hote hain.

navigation.button_text: Sabse Bada Difference: Paise Ka Power ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, ab exam ka sabse bada trap point suno: Purane Planning Commission ke paas rajyon ko PAISA BAANTNE (fund allocate karne) ki taqat thi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya NITI Aayog bhi rajyon ko paisa baant-ti hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi! NITI Aayog ke paas 1 rupaye baantne ki bhi taqat nahi hai. NITI Aayog sirf salah deti hai. Paisa dene ka saara kaam ab Finance Ministry (Vitta Mantralaya) karti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Acha! Planning Commission ke paas paise ki tijori thi, NITI Aayog ke paas sirf salah ki kitaab hai!

quiz_payload.question: Planning Commission aur NITI Aayog ke beech sabse bada ahem antar (difference) kya hai?

options.text: Planning Commission ke paas financial powers the, NITI Aayog sirf advisory hai
NITI Aayog ek samvidhanik sanstha hai
Planning Commission ke head Prime Minister nahi the
Dono bilkul ek jaise hain, koi antar nahi hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Planning Commission rajyon ko fund allocate karti thi, jabki NITI Aayog ke paas fund allocation ka adhikar nahi hai; ye sirf advisory think-tank hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Pehle 5-5 saal ke plan bante the. NITI Aayog ne 5-Year Plan band karke 3 naye time-frame banaye:
1. 15-Year Vision Document (Lamba sapna: jaise 15 saal mein desh ko kahan pahunchana hai)
2. 7-Year Strategy Document (Madhyam rasta: agle 7 saal ka plan)
3. 3-Year Action Agenda (Turant karne wale kaam: agle 3 saal ka action).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab 5 saal ki jagah ab 15, 7 aur 3 saal ka hisab hota hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, kya tumhare ya pados ke school mein 'Atal Tinkering Lab' (ATL) lagi hai, jahan robot aur 3D printer sikhate hain?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan Sir! Bachhe wahan circuit aur robot banana seekhte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ye labs NITI Aayog ke 'Atal Innovation Mission' (AIM) ke tehat lagai jaati hain! Taaki 6th se 12th class ke bache nayi technology aur innovation seekhein.

quiz_payload.question: School ke chhatron mein science aur innovation ko badhava dene wali 'Atal Tinkering Labs' kis sanstha ka initiative hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Atal Tinkering Labs NITI Aayog ke Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) ka hissa hain.

navigation.button_text: Aspirational Districts: Pichhde Zilo Ka Vikas ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 2018 mein NITI Aayog ne 'Aspirational Districts Programme' (Aakankshi Zila Karyakram) chalaya. Desh ke 112 pichhde zilon ko chun kar unme hospital, school aur kheti ko tezise sudhara gaya.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, kya isme hamare Bihar ke bhi zile hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Bihar ke total 13 Zile (jaise Katihar, Begusarai, Sheikhpura, Gaya, Banka aadi) isme shamil kiye gaye. Ye number '13' BPSC mein zaroor pucha jata hai!

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ NITI Aayog ke Aspirational Districts Programme mein Bihar ke kitne zile shamil hain?
quiz_payload.explanation: Bihar ke 13 aakankshi zilon ko NITI Aayog ke Aspirational Districts Programme mein shamil kiya gaya hai.

navigation.button_text: SDG Index: Rajyon Ka Report Card ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: NITI Aayog har saal rajyon ka ek Report Card nikalta hai, jise 'SDG India Index' kehte hain. Isme dekha jata hai ki kaunsa rajya safai, padhai, paani aur bijli mein aage nikal raha hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Report card nikalne se kya hota hai Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Jaise class mein first aane par medal milta hai, waise hi rajyon ke beech accha kaam karne ki hod (Healthy Competition) lagti hai. Isko 'Competitive Federalism' kehte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog ek 'Multidimensional Poverty Index' (MPI) nikalta hai. Pehle garibi sirf paise se naapi jaati thi. Par MPI mein 3 cheezein dekhi jaati hain:
1. Swasthya (Health)
2. Shiksha (Education)
3. Rehan-Sehan (Bijli, Paani, Gas, Shauchalay).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab sirf jeb mein paisa hona kafi nahi, achhi suvidha bhi honi chahiye!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ekdum sahi! Is report mein pata chala ki Bihar mein pichhle kuch saalon mein garibi bahut tezi se kam hui hai.

quiz_payload.question: Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) mein garibi naapne ke 3 mukhya aadhar kaun se hain?

options.text: Health, Education aur Standard of Living

quiz_payload.explanation: MPI mein Swasthya (Health), Shiksha (Education) aur Rehan-Sehan (Standard of Living) ke kul 12 indicators par garibi naapi jaati hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
NITI Aayog ke kuch aur reports ke naam yaad rakhna jo SSC aur BPSC mein match karne aate hain:
• India Innovation Index (Naye aavishkar ki ranking)
• Export Preparedness Index (Videshon mein saman bechne ki taiyari)
• School Education Quality Index (Schools ki quality)
• State Health Index (Hospitals ki quality).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, in sabhi index se har rajya ko apni kamzori pata chal jaati hai!

navigation.button_text: ⭐ Hamare Bihar Ka State Planning Board ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ⭐ Ab aate hain Bihar ke planning par! Jaise desh ke liye Planning Commission/NITI Aayog tha, waise hi Bihar ke liye 'Bihar State Planning Board' (Bihar Rajya Yojna Parishad) hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, Bihar State Planning Board ke Chairman kaun hote hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Jaise desh mein Prime Minister Chairman hote hain, waise hi Bihar mein Bihar ke Chief Minister (Mukhyamantri) iske Chairman hote hain!

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ Bihar Rajya Yojna Parishad (State Planning Board) ke Adhyaksh (Chairman) kaun hote hain?

options.text: Patna High Court ke Chief Justice

quiz_payload.explanation: Bihar State Planning Board ke ex-officio Chairman Bihar ke Chief Minister hote hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
⭐ 2015 mein Bihar sarkar ne vikas ke 7 pakke vaade kiye, jise 'Saat Nischay-1' kaha gaya (2015–2020):
1. Aarthik Hal, Yuvaon ko Bal (Student Credit Card)
2. Aarakshit Rozgar, Mahilaon ka Adhikar (Naukri mein mahilaon ko 35% aarakshan)
3. Har Ghar Bijli Lagataar
4. Har Ghar Nal ka Jal
5. Ghar Tak Pakki Gali-Naliyan
6. Shauchalay Nirman, Ghar ka Samman
7. Awsar Badhe, Aage Padhe.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nal ka jal aur pakki gali to humare gaon mein bhi ban gayi hai!

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ Bihar sarkar ka prasiddh 'Saat Nischay-1' karyakram kis varsh shuru hua tha?
quiz_payload.explanation: Saat Nischay-1 karyakram 2015 mein launch kiya gaya tha (2015–2020).

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
⭐ 2020 mein shuru hua 'Saat Nischay-2' (2020–2025). Iske 7 naye targets hain:
1. Yuva Shakti — Bihar ki Pragati (Mega Skill Centres)
2. Sashakt Mahila — Saksham Mahila (Girls ko graduation pass par ₹50,000)
3. Har Khet Tak Sinchai ka Pani
4. Swachh Gaon — Samriddh Gaon (Solar Street Light)
5. Swachh Shahar — Viksit Shahar
6. Sulabh Samparkata (Flyovers & bypass)
7. Sabke Liye Swasthya Suvidha (Bal Hriday Yojana — dil mein chhed wale bachhon ka free ilaaj).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Meri didi ko graduation pass karne par 50 hazar rupaye mile the!

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ 'Har Khet Tak Sinchai ka Pani' aur 'Swachh Gaon — Samriddh Gaon' kis yojana ke hissa hain?
quiz_payload.explanation: 'Har Khet Tak Sinchai ka Pani' Saat Nischay-2 (2020-2025) ka ahem sankalp hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Bihar ke 3 aur famous schemes exam ke liye rat lo:
1. Bihar Student Credit Card: 12th ke baad aage padhai ke liye 4 Lakh rupaye tak ka aasan loan.
2. Mukhyamantri Balika Cycle Yojana: 9th class ki ladkiyon ko school aane ke liye cycle.
3. Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali Abhiyan (2019): Talab bachane aur ped lagane ke liye!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: School mein cycle yojana se sabhi ladkiyan ab regular school aati hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text:
Bihar sarkar kheti ko aage badhane ke liye 'Krishi Roadmap' banati hai:
• 1st Krishi Roadmap: 2008
• 2nd Krishi Roadmap: 2012–17
• 3rd Krishi Roadmap: 2017–23
• 4th Krishi Roadmap (Abhi active hai): 2023 se 2028 tak!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, 4th Krishi Roadmap ka uddeshya kya hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ganga kinare organic (jaivik) kheti, mote anaj (Millets/Shri Anna) aur kisanon ki aamdani badhana.

quiz_payload.question: ⭐ Bihar sarkar ka 'Chautha Krishi Roadmap' (Krishi Roadmap-4) kab se kab tak ke liye lagu hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Bihar Krishi Roadmap-4 ki avadhi 2023 se 2028 tak hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: BPSC TRE aur BPSC ka favourite sawaal: Har zile mein gaon aur shahar ke plans ko milane ke liye ek 'District Planning Committee' (DPC - Zila Yojna Samiti) banti hai. Iska kanoon Samvidhan ke Article 243ZD mein likha hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Article 243ZD yaad rakhna hai na Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! ZD se yaad rakhna 'Zila Development'!

quiz_payload.question: Bhartiya Samvidhan ke kis Article mein 'District Planning Committee' (Zila Yojna Samiti) ka pravdhan hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: 74th Constitutional Amendment ke dwara Article 243ZD ke tehat District Planning Committee (DPC) ka pravdhan kiya gaya hai.

navigation.button_text: Planning Kis List Mein Aati Hai? ➔

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Samvidhan ki 7th Schedule mein 3 lists hoti hain: Union List (Kendra), State List (Rajya), aur Concurrent List (Samvarti - dono ke liye). 'Economic and Social Planning' (Aarthik aur Samajik Yojna) Concurrent List (Item 20) mein aati hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab Kendra Sarkar aur Bihar Sarkar dono vikas ke plan bana sakte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi samjhe Raju!

quiz_payload.question: Bhartiya Samvidhan mein 'Aarthik aur Samajik Yojna' (Planning) kis soochi (list) ka vishay hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Planning 7th Schedule ki Concurrent List (Samvarti Soochi) ke Entry 20 par darj hai.

summary_payload.title: ⚖️ Planning Commission vs NITI Aayog: Ek Nazar Mein

revision_points.point: PC: 15 March 1950 | NITI: 1 January 2015
Dono hi Extra-Constitutional / Non-Statutory hain (Cabinet ke aadesh se bane)
Dono ke Chairman Prime Minister hote hain
PC ke paas funds baantne ki power thi | NITI ke paas zero fund power hai (sirf salah)
PC mein states ki kam sunwai thi | NITI ki Governing Council mein sabhi CMs member hain
PC: 5-Saal ka rigid plan | NITI: 15-Year Vision, 7-Year Strategy, 3-Year Action

quiz_payload.question:
Kathan (A): NITI Aayog ko ek 'Think Tank' ke roop mein jaana jata hai.

Karan (R): NITI Aayog kendra aur rajya sarkaron ko policy aur strategy par salah (advice) deta hai, funds allocate nahi karta.

Sahi vikalp chunein:

options.text: A aur R dono sahi hain, aur R, A ki sahi vyakhya karta hai
A aur R dono sahi hain, par R vyakhya nahi karta
A sahi hai par R galat hai
A galat hai par R sahi hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Dono kathan sahi hain. NITI Aayog ko think-tank isliye kehte hain kyunki ye technical aur strategic advice deta hai, financial powers nahi rakhta.

quiz_payload.question:
⭐ Kathan (A): Bihar Sarkar ka Saat Nischay Karyakram rajya ke sarvangin vikas ka blueprint hai.

Karan (R): Saat Nischay-2 mein 'Yuva Shakti', 'Sashakt Mahila' aur 'Har Khet Tak Sinchai' jaise 7 ahem kshetra shamil hain.

Sahi vikalp chunein:

options.text: A aur R dono sahi hain, aur R, A ki sahi vyakhya karta hai
A aur R dono sahi hain, par R vyakhya nahi karta
A sahi hai par R galat hai
A galat hai par R sahi hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Dono bilkul sahi hain aur Reason ye batata hai ki Saat Nischay kaise har tabqe aur sector ko cover karke holistic development karta hai.

quiz_payload.question:
Consider the following statements:
1. NITI Aayog was established on 1 January 2015.
2. All Chief Ministers of States are members of NITI Aayog's Governing Council.
3. Bihar State Planning Board is chaired by the Governor of Bihar.
4. Atal Tinkering Labs are an initiative of NITI Aayog.

How many statements are CORRECT?
quiz_payload.explanation: Statements 1, 2, and 4 are CORRECT. Statement 3 is WRONG because the Bihar State Planning Board is chaired by the Chief Minister, not the Governor.

quiz_payload.question: NITI Aayog ke pehle Vice-Chairperson (Upaadhyaksh) kaun the?
quiz_payload.explanation: Arvind Panagariya NITI Aayog ke pehle Vice-Chairperson the.

quiz_payload.question:
⭐ Sahi Jodi Milayein:
(A) Saat Nischay-1 Launch — (1) 2023 se 2028
(B) Saat Nischay-2 Launch — (2) 2015
(C) Bihar Krishi Roadmap-4 — (3) 2020

Sahi option chunein:
quiz_payload.explanation: Saat Nischay-1: 2015; Saat Nischay-2: 2020; Krishi Roadmap-4: 2023-2028.

revision_points.point: 1934 Visvesvaraya Kitaab ➔ 1938 Nehru NPC ➔ 1950 JP Sarvodaya Plan
15 March 1950 ko bana | Extra-Constitutional | PM Chairman
1st Kheti (1951) ➔ 2nd Steel (1956) ➔ Holiday (1966-69) ➔ 12th Last Plan (2012-17)
1 Jan 2015 ko bana | Think Tank | Sabhi CMs member | No financial powers
State Planning Board (CM Head) | Saat Nischay-1 (2015) | Saat Nischay-2 (2020) | Krishi Roadmap-4 (2023-28)
Concurrent List Entry 20 (Planning) | Article 243ZD (District Planning Committee)

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Aman Sir, sach mein maza aa gaya! 8th class ke level se shuru karke maine 1934 se lekar NITI Aayog aur Bihar Saat Nischay tak ka sab kuch bina kisi confusion ke seekh liya!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Ye hui na baat Raju! Ab chahe BPSC ho, BPSC TRE ho ya SSC CGL — tumhara koi bhi question galat nahi hoga. Tumne zero se shuru karke officer-level ki tayyari kar li hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Thank you Aman Sir! Ab exam mein top rank laana hai! 🎯
